declared_build_goals:
The campaign followed the actual development order (516 commits, oldest to newest):
1. Foundation: monorepo consolidation, 0G compute streaming + wallet-signed sessions, Railway/Vercel deploy, motion/UX polish, IA simplification.
2. Production hardening waves 1-7: auth guards, TEE signature verification, prod auth allowlist, dead-code elimination, security gap fixes, brand identity.
3. Deep audits: 43-finding perf/security audit, 7-agent 0G deep-dive, ERC-7857 spec alignment (nonce, events, signatures), tx-merge research (34 to 31 on-chain txs).
4. Contracts V2: TimelockManager, UUPS conversion of all three upgradeable contracts, bytecode under the 24KB EIP-170 limit, ABI auto-generation, indexer merged into backend, WS broadcast wired to EventStore.
5. Optimization campaigns: 10-cycle dead-code/clone/allocation reduction, full bun-native migration, OZ 5.6.1 + solc upgrades, 2.27x faster forge builds, warning convergence to zero.
6. UX + protocol: chat UX overhaul (P0-P3), transfer co-sign completion, i18n contract, CSS audit (11 phases), live Galileo e2e green, storage transcript persistence, 0G adoption items (RPC fallbacks, storage canary, DEK custody, keeper module).
7. V3 contract campaign (this submission's wave): security fixes, Permit2 settlement, DelegationRegistry, full deploy, statefold, GasTank gasless UX, DeFi rails, mainnet prep, canonical digest fix, sponsored DeFi chat tools.
product_category_justification: The agent itself is the product (ERC-7857 iNFT with gasless chat tools), the swap/lend treasury is the DeFi surface, and the GasTank/relayer is 0G infrastructure any other builder can adopt — all three are live, so the pick costs nothing in honesty.
updates_in_this_wave:
Axiom Protocol is production-built on 0G from day one: an ERC-7857 agent marketplace where a wallet with zero gas claims a 0.01 OG grant, pays agents, swaps, borrows, and delegates — every step verified by an on-chain end-to-end run.

Built across 516 commits (single continuous campaign, committed in development order):
- Foundation: full Bun-native monorepo (backend, frontend, contracts, chat-runtime, config) — pnpm dropped, 2.5x faster builds, compile binaries, zero-clone audits, single-source env/config, zod schemas, CI drift gates (ABI drift, stale OpenAPI).
- ERC-7857 contract suite: AgentNFT with TEE-signed transfer proofs and sealed-DEK re-keying, iClone, delegateAccess; UUPS proxies with ERC-7201 namespaces; TeeVerifier with append-only signer allowlist and immediate-revoke containment; TimelockManager (now 10-minute) on fees/upgrades/verifier rotation; EIP-7201 slot tests, fuzz suites, gas benchmarks.
- AxiomGasTank: lazy 0.01 OG grants, per-user sequential nonces, ERC-1271 dual-path signing, relayer reimbursement clamped three ways, solvency invariant fuzz-verified over 257 runs — built so agents pay their own gas from their own tank.
- ERC-2771 retrofit of AgentNFT and PaymentProcessor; relayer with EIP-712 recovery, eth_call simulation, rate gating, dead-lettering; swap pool, LP shares, collateralized lending inside the PaymentProcessor — DeFi rails with zero extra contracts; axmUSDC/axmWETH, 1,000-token faucet.
- Sponsored chat tools: pay, withdraw, swap_tokens, borrow run gas-free behind a server-side DeFi calldata gate; canonical EIP-712 digest hardening (browser E2E caught live signature drift, fixed, redeployed, digest parity verified on-chain, drift-guard test).
- 0G stack depth: Storage Turbo (encrypted payloads, chat transcripts, sealed-DEK custody, AES-256 transport, merkle proofs, canary wrong-key detection), Compute router (wallet-signed sessions, model config, live-verified streaming), Multicall3 chain override, Pyth prices, honest DA evaluation (ADR-002).

Evidence: 907 tests green (forge 343/0 across 23 suites, backend 249, chat-runtime 100, config 62, frontend 153). Live contracts on 0G: AgentNFT 0xe32f87C6F8070C89a82D51BDd3fab578C0d7be6f, Processor 0xe6956f663103c6E1e5077c3256c453b95924112a, Vault 0xe8B3B31E5CE0436cCfD19a47351943CcB7703722, TeeVerifier 0x4938F10B12051CE8DCd70E3F7555E71adb432545, GasTank 0xF19245876Cd6Cb115810D459B00e94130591CAaa, DelegationRegistry 0xeA411cC163CAab2678E3E40dF3C1622EB28CCD58. App: https://axiom-protocol.vercel.app · Code: https://github.com/symulacr/axiom-protocol

Mainnet-ready: DeployAristotle.s.sol deploys and wires all seven instances behind 7 pre-broadcast safety gates — paymentToken admin-swappable to canonical USDC.e, grants default off, key separation enforced; default network is mainnet. 0G primitives: Chain, Storage, Compute, Permit2, Pyth; DA evaluated and declined with reasons (ADR-002).
fourth_wave_milestone: Default network is Aristotle mainnet (16661): the gated one-command deployment (DeployAristotle.s.sol, 7 safety gates, already simulated) cut overs all contract instances and env, and the proof-of-success is a judge connecting any wallet at the demo URL and completing a gas-free agent payment directly on mainnet.
fifth_wave:
1. Mainnet execution. Run DeployAristotle.s.sol on 16661 — deploys and wires all seven instances behind the 7 pre-broadcast safety gates (non-zero pay cap, real swap pair, grants opt-in only, admin wiring under the second oracle-admin broadcast, post-broadcast assertion wall). Env cutover per ADR-004 ordering.
2. Relayer funding + public demo. Fund the relayer EOA to >=0.5 OG (~800 sponsored ops at 0.0006 OG/op) and record one replayable mainnet session: fresh wallet claims grant, sponsored swap + borrow, every op carrying a Relayed tx hash.
3. Relayer durability. Persist the sponsorship queue behind the EventStore; deadline-bounded signatures already allow re-submission.
4. Lending v2. External Pyth price for LP collateral valuation, interest accrual, liquidation path.
5. Ops: owner sweep helper for the retired tank (0.1 OG) and an off-chain alarm on swapSolvency() so pool solvency is monitored continuously.
6. Params behind the live 10-minute timelock: swap fee, borrow factor, grants; delegation card wired to the DelegationRegistry in the same cutover.
